query: Who played Rocket in the movie called 'Guardians of the Galaxy'?
sql_query: SELECT distinct p.name FROM people p JOIN crew c ON p.person_id = c.person_id JOIN titles t ON c.title_id = t.title_id WHERE t.original_title  = 'Guardians of the Galaxy' AND t."type" = 'movie' AND c."characters" LIKE '%Rocket%'
